📖 Explanation:

Ayrton Senna was comfortably leading on lap 49 of 51 at Monza, looking to maintain McLaren's unbroken victory streak during the 1988 season.

While trying to lap Jean-Louis Schlesser—who was making a one-off appearance for Williams in place of an ill Nigel Mansell—the two collided at the Rettifilo chicane, beaching Senna's car.

The incident handed Ferrari an emotional 1-2 finish led by Gerhard Berger, less than a month after founder Enzo Ferrari had passed away.
